method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, version in force from 1 July 2026 (First Schedule paragraph 1 as amended by S 886/2025 wef 1 January 2026); with the Central Provident Fund (Exemption) Order 2018, 2025 Revised Edition, version in force from 1 June 2026 (CPFA1953-OR10.txt), and the Central Provident Fund (Self-Employed Persons) Regulations 1992, version in force from 1 January 2026 (CPFA1953-RG25.txt)
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run cpf-cases-contributions.l4 ; l4 run cpf-cases-self-employed.l4 ; l4 run cpf-cases-withdrawal.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: s 2 'applicable person'; s 15(1), (2), (3), (6)(a) and (c); s 16(1); s 24(2), (3A), (3B); s 25(1)(a)(i) and (ii), (3)(a), (5)(a); s 7(1), (2), (3), (5), (6), (6A); First Schedule paras 1 and 5(a)(i), (b), (c), (ea); s 13(4) with the Minister's ratios as inputs; Exemption Order paras 2 to 5 and the Schedule; s 9A, s 8A(9), s 9(2), (3), s 58(1)(e), s 61(1); Self-Employed Persons Regulations regs 2(1), 2A, 3(1), 4(1)(m), 7A(2), (3), 8A, 14 and First Schedule item 23
seat: the member of the Fund (the employee or self-employed person whose CPF it is)
